author: Cinna Davis (OpenAI Codex assisted)
statement: A written transfer replaces low-height integer crossing factors and normalizers by uniform exact rational entry generation in 2^O(lambda) bit time and two rational rank bounds. One boundedly sampled polynomial-bit prime avoids all possible parameter denominators with success above 99/100, generic field factors keep the ranks, and exact signed recovery of every original integer network query preserves the outer comparisons and modulo-two reduction. Every random outcome has the charged source master time envelope; failure flags yield one-sided decision error. Exponential space is explicit. No smaller rho or selected SAT improvement is obtained.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the uniform rational transfer, all-query bounds and complete cost argument
A cheaper valid rational crossing family with both required rank bounds, polynomial piece count and uniform generation
Full implementation of the master/SAT algorithm and production primality routine is not supplied by the bounded component checkers
Polynomial-space generic factor generation, if that guarantee is desired
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; author-checked, no independent or formal review
